detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

LC 120 (Lipo-C formulation)

Chemical Information: (Methionine)
  • Chemical Name: L-Methionine
  • Molecular Formula: C5H11NO2S
  • Molecular Weight: 149.21 g/mol
Chemical Information: (Choline Chloride)
  • Chemical Name: Choline Chloride
  • Molecular Formula: C5H14ClNO
  • Molecular Weight: 139.62 g/mol
Chemical Information: (Carnitine)
  • Chemical Name: L-Carnitine
  • Molecular Formula: C7H15NO3
  • Molecular Weight: 161.20 g/mol
Chemical Information: (Dexpanthenol)
  • Chemical Name: D-Panthenol (Dexpanthenol)
  • Molecular Formula: C9H19NO4
  • Molecular Weight: 205.25 g/mol
Product Description:

LC120 is a multi-component liquid research formulation composed of four well-characterized non-peptide compounds: methionine, choline chloride, carnitine, and dexpanthenol. Each component is supplied in a defined quantity and combined into a single aqueous solution to support controlled laboratory research applications involving formulated compound systems. The designation “LC” refers to Liquid Compound, while “120” represents the total combined mass of the formulated compounds contained in each bottle. This product is not intended for injection or any human or veterinary use.

Research Applications:
  • Evaluation of multi-compound liquid formulations in laboratory environments
  • Investigation of compound compatibility and stability in aqueous systems
  • Analytical research involving combined non-peptide compounds
  • Comparative studies of formulated liquid research mixtures
Storage and Handling:
  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration is recommended before and/or after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised.
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Handle using aseptic laboratory techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Formulation: Aqueous solution
  • Total Compound Content: 120 mg per bottle
  • Composition:
  • Methionine: 15 mg
  • Choline Chloride: 50 mg
  • Carnitine: 50 mg
  • Dexpanthenol: 5 mg
  • Volume: 10 mL
  • Appearance: Clear liquid
  • Analytical Testing: Component-verified
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Certificate of Analysis (COA): Available via QR code or COA-archive
Compliance Notice:

LC120 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
